dsa-v1-d10-repair-traversal.alternative: const levelOrder=root=>{let layer=root?[root]:[];const out=[];while(layer.length){const next=[];for(const node of layer){out.push(node.value);if(node.left)next.push(node.left);if(node.right)next.push(node.right);}layer=next;}return out;};

dsa-v1-d10-frequency-index.alternative: const mostFrequent=(values,queries)=>{const counts=new Map();for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++)counts.set(values[i],(counts.get(values[i])??0)+1);const result=[];for(const query of queries)result.push(counts.get(query)??0);return result;};
